items.title: IND vs NZ second Test: Akash Deep takes five wickets as India dismisses New Zealand for 356
items.text: Akash Deep was the standout bowler for India, returning impressive figures of 5 for 99, while Brar (2/78) and Anshul Kamboj (2/79) claimed two wickets apiece

items.title: Nathan Lyon’s 13-year reign as Australia’s top-choice spinner ends
items.text: Australia axes Nathan Lyon after 13 years as lead spinner; squad includes Rocchiccioli and Clayton for the New Zealand Test series.

items.title: INLD leader alleges Haryana universities saddled with ₹16,052 crore debt
items.text: The State government has pushed 22 public universities into a debt burden over the past four years by converting grants-in-aid into perpetual loans.

items.title: Centre proposes freeze on Lok Sabha seat proportions for States until 2051
items.text: The new Constitutional Amendment Bill, accompanied by a fresh Delimitation Bill, proposes to increase the number of Lok Sabha seats in each State by 50%; they also bring into force the 33% reservation for women in the Lok Sabha
